name: 80109 · Castle Rock, CO
findings: ZIP 80109 (Castle Rock) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80109 (Castle Rock) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80109 (Castle Rock) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
